entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.

2. The applicant who is in custody since 28.12.2022 has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Korrah P.S. Case No.291 of 2022, registered for the offence under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 4 of the POCSO Act, pending in the court of learned A.D.J.-III, Special Judge, POCSO Act, Hazaribag.
3. It appears that the applicant is accused of committing rape upon his sister who is minor.

4. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of FIR along with its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
5. Innocence has been claimed by the learned counsel for the applicant and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
It has been submitted that the families are in dispute and this case has been lodged to settle the family dispute.

As per the prosecution story, the FIR has been Roshan Kumar Mehta @ Roushan Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... ... on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85990868/
1 lodged after three years of the incident.

entities.text: Roshan Kumar Mehta @ Roushan Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.
6. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.
7. Considering the statement of the girl made under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C. and the medical report, I am not inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail, at this stage.
Accordingly, the present bail application stands rejected.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Amar/-
